description: This file defines the class AttributeDiscoveryWithAnnotations, which extends AttributeClassDiscovery to enable plugin discovery using both attributes and annotations in Drupal. It manages annotation reading, class parsing, and cache suffix generation for plugin definitions.

classes.name: AttributeDiscoveryWithAnnotations
classes.description: A class that discovers plugin definitions using both PHP attributes and annotations, with methods for parsing classes, managing annotation readers, and generating cache suffixes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the discovery class with plugin subdirectory, root namespaces, and optional annotation and attribute names.

methods.name: getFileCacheSuffix
methods.description: Generates a cache suffix string based on the default suffix, additional namespaces, and annotation name.

methods.name: getDefinitions
methods.description: Resets annotation registry, retrieves plugin definitions from parent, and resets the annotation reader.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses a class for plugin definition, first via attributes, then via annotations if needed, returning plugin ID and content.

methods.name: prepareAnnotationDefinition
methods.description: Sets class and provider information on the annotation object based on the class being parsed.

methods.name: getAnnotationReader
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the annotation reader, adding relevant namespaces for annotation parsing.
